items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Levi Fern. [INTERVIEWEE] By Martin. Yeah, by Martin. That's what I said.

ctx.x: Soapsuds by the, what, St. Louis? Levy Serenade. Levy Serenade, yeah. Okay. Okay record. I, well, as a matter of fact, I didn't have it. My nephew had that. See, I dropped out of all interest in music, you may say, just about the time Jelly Roll was coming into prominence. And I went to Georgetown at night for four years while I was working, and I was busy as I hoped to be, and I don't want to be again. And I dropped every other interest that I had, you know, just to get through Georgetown. And my nephew, in the…
By Martin. Yeah, by Martin. That's what I said.
